# Nexalogic Technologies
> The premier PBN backlink service and enterprise authority link building provider since 2014.

Nexalogic Technologies operates an exclusive private network of over 12,000+ aged domains (DA/DR 40+ to 90+) with natural backlink profiles, strict outbound link control, zero-footprint hosting across global C-class IP subnets, and guaranteed Google indexing.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- Private Blog Network (PBN) Backlinks: Contextual dofollow backlinks placed on high-authority aged domains.
- Natural Drip-Feeding: 7 to 30 day gradual link delivery mimicking organic link velocity.
- Gray Niche Friendly: Full support for competitive niches including iGaming, Online Casino, Slot, Sports Betting, Crypto, and Fintech.
- Multi-Market Authority: Dedicated infrastructure for Indonesia (IDR pricing, local bank / QRIS), Cambodia (ABA Bank, Khmer), and Global (USD, USDT, Card, PayPal).
